source.title: Pima County Recorder — early ballot status
source.notes: Official daily general-election status, as of end of source day. When multiple ballots are sent to a voter, only the last ballot issued is included in these status totals. Returns include ballots awaiting verification or follow-up; they are not votes counted.

metrics.label: Ballots Sent (latest issue)

metrics.label: Ballots Verified and Ready to be Turned Over
metrics.definition: Source category for verified ballots awaiting turnover; excludes ballots already turned over. Do not treat as all accepted ballots.

metrics.label: Ballots Turned Over to the Elections Department
metrics.definition: Recorder-to-Elections transfer count; turnover is not tabulation or candidate votes.

source_warnings: Pima source figures: returned 190232 + not yet returned 304160 = 494392, versus Ballots Sent 494284 (difference +108). Source values retained without adjustment; processing categories must not be treated as a synchronized accounting identity.
